name: event-staff
description: Waiters, bar staff, hosts and helpers for events.

jobs.description: What the staff do, such as serving, bar or cloakroom.

headcount.description: How many people the seller provides.

howDealsGo: The buyer pays into escrow at booking and releases after the shift. Done is every person there for the whole shift, doing the agreed job. A timer to the seller, set past the event, pays for a shift worked if the buyer goes quiet. Before paying, agree what the staff wear and who feeds them.
